hero.label: OUR PROGRAMS
hero.description: Our programs are designed to help students build a strong relationship with the Quran, improve their recitation, memorize with confidence, and develop Islamic knowledge.

intro.label: WHAT WE OFFER
intro.title: Programs Designed for Every Learning Journey
intro.description: At Jafar Madrasa, we understand that every student has a different learning journey. Our programs provide structured Quranic and Islamic education while allowing students to progress according to their abilities and goals.

cards.title: Quran Recitation
cards.description: Students learn to read the Quran correctly and confidently while developing accurate pronunciation and consistent recitation habits.

cards.title: Hifz Program
cards.description: A structured program for students who want to memorize the Quran while maintaining regular revision and strengthening their memorization.

cards.title: Tajweed
cards.description: Students learn the rules of Tajweed and apply them during Quran recitation to improve accuracy and pronunciation.

cards.title: Islamic Studies
cards.description: Students develop foundational Islamic knowledge and learn important principles that help them understand and practice their faith.

learning.label: HOW STUDENTS LEARN
learning.title: A Structured Learning Journey
learning.description: We combine regular lessons, practice, progress tracking, and teacher guidance to support every student’s development.

steps.title: Learn
steps.description: Students receive lessons and guidance from their Quran teachers.

steps.title: Practice
steps.description: Students practice their recitation, memorization, and Islamic knowledge regularly.

steps.title: Progress
steps.description: Teachers monitor each student’s progress and provide feedback throughout their learning journey.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Students build confidence, consistency, knowledge, and a stronger connection with the Quran.

parents.label: PARENTS & STUDENTS
parents.title: Keeping Parents Connected to Their Child’s Progress
parents.description: We believe parents play an important role in a student’s Quranic education. Teachers can provide regular updates about attendance, lessons, memorization, and Quranic progress so parents can stay informed about their child’s learning journey.

cta.label: START LEARNING
cta.title: Begin Your Quranic Learning Journey
cta.description: Give your child the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop a lifelong connection with the Quran.
